privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Mizania helps students see how much they can spend each day until the next transfer from home. This page explains, in simple words, what we store and why.

sections.title: What we store
body: Your account: your first name and email address. If you sign up with a password, we store only a scrambled version (a hash) of it, never the password itself.

If you continue with Google: the name, email address and profile photo link that Google shares with us, and the identifiers Google gives us to sign you in. We store Google's sign-in tokens encrypted and don't use them to read anything else from your Google account.
Your settings: your language, weekly mode and check-in time.
What you type into the app: your wallets (their names and the balances you enter), transactions, budget plans and evening check-ins.
For security: for each signed-in device, its IP address and browser type, and short-lived records of sign-in attempts to stop password guessing.

sections.title: What we never do
body: We never sell your data or share it for advertising.
We don't show ads and don't use tracking or analytics tools.
We never connect to your bank, D17 or Flouci. You enter your balances yourself.
The app never sends or moves money.
Nobody else, including your family, can see your data. If the app helps you write a message to ask for money, it only gives you text to copy; nothing is sent automatically.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: Only to run Mizania: to sign you in, calculate your daily amount, show your history, send you emails you need (confirming your email, resetting your password) and keep your account secure.

sections.title: Who helps us run the app
body: Vercel hosts the app. Its servers run in Frankfurt, Germany.
Neon stores the database, also in Frankfurt.
Google sends our emails (Gmail) and, if you choose it, signs you in with your Google account.
They process data only to provide these services to us.

sections.title: Cookies and data on your phone
body: We use two cookies: one that keeps you signed in (for 30 days) and one that remembers your language. The app also saves its own files on your phone so it opens without a connection.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: As long as you have an account. When you delete your account, we delete your data.

sections.title: Your choices
body: Export your data: coming soon.
Delete your account from the app: coming soon. Until then, write to us at {contact} from your account's email address and we'll delete it.

sections.title: Changes
body: If this policy changes in an important way, we'll tell you in the app or by email before it applies.

sections.title: Contact
body: Questions about your data: {contact}.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use Mizania. Please read them; they are short.

sections.title: What Mizania is
body: A free budgeting app for students. It shows how much you can spend each day until your next transfer, based only on what you enter.

sections.title: Not financial advice
body: The amounts the app shows are estimates from your own entries. They are not financial advice, and you decide how to spend your money.

sections.title: No money moves through Mizania
body: Mizania never connects to banks, D17 or Flouci and never sends money. Wallets are tracked by hand. The "ask for money" feature only writes text for you to copy.

sections.title: Your account
body: Use your own email address and keep your password private. One account is for one person. You're responsible for what happens in your account.

sections.title: Fair use
body: Don't misuse the app: no attacks, no attempts to access other people's data, no automated mass sign-ups and nothing illegal.

sections.title: Your data
body: What you enter stays yours. You allow us to store and process it only to run the app for you, as described in the privacy policy.

sections.title: The service
body: Mizania is provided as it is, without guarantees. We work to keep it available and correct, but it may have errors or stop for a while. Features may change. If we ever close the service, we'll tell you in advance.

sections.title: Closing your account
body: You can stop using Mizania at any time and ask us to delete your account (in the app soon; until then by email at {contact}). We may suspend accounts that break these terms.

sections.title: Changes and contact
body: If these terms change in an important way, we'll tell you before it applies. Questions: {contact}.
